edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender, the deployer.
Chire uses msg.sender as the transferFrom source for airdrops.
tx.origin is consumed by the transfer delay bookkeeping operation.
The timestamp mapping is written using tx.origin as key.
_transfer reads tx.origin to enforce one purchase per block.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against the holder's first buy timestamp for early sell tax.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in addLiquidity.
Router instance is used to execute the token to ETH swap.
Router instance is used to add liquidity.
Pair address is compared against from/to and used to detect buys.
AMM pair mapping determines buy/sell branches and fee application.
Fee exemption mapping bypasses trading gate, fees and swap trigger checks.
Max transaction exemption mapping bypasses buy/sell limits.
maxTransactionAmount is enforced on buys and sells.
maxWallet limits recipient balance growth.
Blacklist mapping blocks transfers and is mutated by anti-bot logic.
tradingActive gates transfers for non-excluded accounts.
The swapping boolean acts as a reentrancy guard around swapBack.
_transfer invokes swapBack before completing the final token transfer, exposing state to external calls.
swapBack performs a low-level value call to devWallet, handing control to an external address.
swapBack performs a low-level value call to marketingWallet with the whole remaining balance.
swapBack delegates the token to ETH swap to swapTokensForEth.
swapBack delegates liquidity provision to addLiquidity.
devWallet is the destination of the low-level ETH transfer.
marketingWallet is the destination of the low-level ETH transfer.
swapTokensAtAmount caps and triggers the swapBack routine.
tokensForMarketing drives the ETH split in swapBack.
tokensForLiquidity drives the liquidity portion in swapBack.
tokensForDev drives the dev ETH split in swapBack.
_transfer computes fees and subtracts them from the amount before the final transfer.
sellTotalFees is the divisor/multiplier in the fee arithmetic.
swapTokensForEth calls the router's fee-on-transfer swap, an external untrusted call.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates the mapping write to the internal setter.
Internal setter writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount after bound checks.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
setEarlySellTax writes enableEarlySellTax.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true permanently.
enableTrading records launchedAt as the current block number.
enableTrading enables swapping.
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
blacklistAccount writes the _blacklist mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees from owner supplied values.
